item: zero-iteration audit: seven asserting loops over empty results fixed, each proven by a mutant that stayed green
refs: no PR number in the row
summary: Counted the iterations of 2937 asserting for-loops across the suite (plugin outside the repo, three shards): 12 never iterate. Four are empty tables by design and one (recursive_logs flags_only_bare_scans) is a sound guard; seven were vacuous and each had a source mutant that stayed green under the old test: emergence, headline_body, lonely_signal, multi-word query expansion, recency report rows, the aux inline-js lookahead, and the kept-store logs. Each test now makes the result non-empty and asserts it, and its mutant goes red. Test-only; no src change.
